subject: planner: remove duplicate offset when push down pure limit down across outer join (#59927)
summary: Reviewed the planner change in `LogicalJoin.PushDownTopN`: when `pushDownTopNToChild` determines the TopN (including OFFSET) can be fully pushed below an outer join and eliminated (`topnEliminated=true`), the code now returns the join directly for pure LIMIT/OFFSET (no `ByItems`) instead of re-attaching the original TopN, preventing duplicate OFFSET/LIMIT application. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, or runtime/transaction/privilege issues found within the commit’s planner changes.
